title: IFTA return missing credit for fuel bought without miles
text: Fleet accounting is overpaying on the Q3 IFTA return for tractor 4417. The driver bought 300 tax-paid gallons in Idaho for a Hartline load that was cancelled before it moved, so the quarter shows Idaho fuel but no Idaho miles. Our return has no ID line, which means the $99.00 credit is gone and the total comes out $99.00 too high. The return is built by `ifta_return` in `ifta.py`.
